title: Will Wright GDC 2005 Spore (The Future of Content) Remastered
summary: A remastered recording of Will Wright's 2005 GDC talk revealing Spore, titled The Future of Content. He covers procedurally generated content and the ambitions of the game, with gameplay demo starting around 12:30.
why: HN points to it for Wright's ideas on procedural design and as the source of the huge expectations around Spore.

quote.text: a talk by Will Wright on the (originally planned) procedurally generated design of Spore lives rent free in my brain
